Imperial Chicken - Rice
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 19, 2009 - 11:48pm

Ingredients




2 broiler fryer chicken breasts, skinned, boned, cu
1/2 cup peanut or sesame oil
3 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 cup finely chopped cashews
1 cup thinly sliced mushrooms
1/2 teaspoon seasoned salt
1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper
1 cup uncooked rice
10 ounces pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed, uncooked
3 cups chicken broth
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
2 cups bean sprouts
12 tiny cherry tomatoes

Preparation

1 Have all ingredients prepared and ready to stir fry. Using a wok or electric fry pan, heat oil over medium heat, stir fry chicken one minute. Put aside. Stir fry garlic, nuts, mushrooms and seasonings for one minute, put aside. Add rice, stir fry till light golden color. Mix in the previously stir fried ingredients, add broccoli, stir fry one minute.
